title: A complete waste of money.
text: A complete waste of money.. The product was extremely easy to assemble. That’s where the positive review ends. I still have the table and have not requested a refund, but I will not buy it again nor say that you should waste your money on it. It’s extremely flimsy and cannot bear any type of weight, especially drinks. Plus it does not lock in the three different positions. So, should you make the mistake like I did and lift it to pull it toward you while your dinner is on it, you may end up with a disaster also.

product_metadata.title: Table Mate II TV Tray Table - Folding TV Dinner Table, Couch Table Trays for Eating Snack Food, Stowaway Laptop Stand, Portable Bed Dinner Tray - Adjustable TV Table with 3 Angles, Cup Holder, White

COMFORTABLE: Always easy and convenient to use. Its L-shaped legs are designed to fit over any surface and around any obstacle. Super convenient as a breakfast in bed tray, portable desk for dorm room, or couch tray for solitaire and puzzles.
